text: The factory gets an identity of its own: an "Invariant Factory" GitHub App, installed on gitdek/invariant only. It comments, commits, opens pull requests and merges as its bot. Only people's comments can ratify, and @gitdek's own commits stay his. The App has no Workflows permission, so its token can't edit CI. Amends D-0036, where the factory posted as @gitdek.
